headline: 926 billion soms accumulated in banks and microfinance companies of Kyrgyzstan
summary: Total deposits at commercial banks and microfinance companies in Kyrgyzstan have reached 926 billion soms, according to an executive director quoted in the report. The figure covers the sector's combined deposit base.
why: Deposit volumes measure the funding base of a country's banking and microfinance sector, which underpins lending and domestic credit growth.
original_headline: В банках и микрофинансовых компаниях Кыргызстана накоплено 926 миллиардов сомов
